backgrounds.name: Disgraced Audit Clerk
backgrounds.description: You once balanced Chancery ledgers before noticing whole regiments of debtors vanished without burial.

backgrounds.name: Ash-Quarry Escapee
backgrounds.description: Years hauling pale-iron ore left you scarred, stubborn, and impossible to break.

backgrounds.name: Mist-Weir Ferryhand
backgrounds.description: You poled arrival barges through black fog long enough to memorize every hidden pier.

backgrounds.name: Last-Bell Apprentice
backgrounds.description: Raised among the bronze-founders, you hear truth and falsehood like clean or cracked bells.

backgrounds.name: Dockside Debt-Skipper
backgrounds.description: You survived the Drowned Piers by staying two alleys ahead of every bailiff.

backgrounds.name: Lantern-Wall Veteran
backgrounds.description: You held the rusted viaduct until you realized the Chancery was starving your post on purpose.
